items.title: LiveOne Inc (LVO) (Q2 2027) Earnings Call Highlights: Record EBITDA, Major B2B Partnerships and ...
items.summary: LiveOne Inc (LVO) posted record first-half EBITDA of $7.8 million, up 619% year-over-year, while outlining plans for a massive B2B launch and over $100 million in revenue next year.
